[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.42 (Sādhanapāda) — Saṃtoṣādanuttamaḥ sukhalābhaḥ | Pages 519-521]

aḥ / Tṛṣṇāpratibandhāpagame ca cittasya
svābhāvikasattvādhikyanimittakā sukhasvabhāvatā svata evāvir bhavati, na tatsukhe viṣayāpekṣeti tan
nirviṣayaṃ śāntisukham, ātmasukham ucyate, te ye śataṃ prajāpater ānandāḥ sa eko brahmaṇa
ānandaḥ śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya ityādiśruteḥ / Īśvarasya pūrṇakāmatvāt śrotriyasya ca jñānena
kāmakṣayād ubhayor eva vaitṛṣṇyasya tulyatayā samānaṃ sukham ity āśayaḥ / Buddheḥ
sattvātmakatayā sukhasvabhāvatvena jīve'pi nityaṃ sukham idam eva gīyate, svābhāvikasya yāvad
dravyabhāvitvāt / Tamasā pihitatvena ca sadānabhivyaktatvāt / Na punaś citir eva sukhasvarūpiṇī,
cinmātratvaśrutismṛtisūtravirodhāder uktatvād iti /
« Du contentement résulte l'acquisition d'un plaisir indépassable.
